title: Broaden the licence and qualification model in the Workforce Registry
requirements:
- Use a governed licence-status value set including not applicable, provisional, restricted and relicensed states
- Separate formal qualifications, certifications, CPD and scope-of-practice authorisations
- Model licences with scope, jurisdiction, conditions and non-fixed expiry
- Support multiple licences and licences without expiry
- Support multiple qualifications, with place of training (national/foreign) for each
- Model qualifications and specialisations as repeatable, verified records with issuing authority
- Record status reason, scope, jurisdiction and effective period separately
- Make specialisation conditionally mandatory
